law: CONTRACT PINNED BEFORE ANY SHIM (W8 law carried) — W18_GDX2DPIXMAP_CONTRACT.json was pinned (objdump call-face of the APK's own libgdx.so/libgdx-freetype.so + androguard DEX face) before any slot implementation; every further fix was root-caused through the same oracle chain before the edit.

implemented_laws.F-NEW-605: JNIEnv slots 222/223/229 — GetPrimitiveArrayCritical / ReleasePrimitiveArrayCritical (spec copy semantics, mode-0 commit, JNI_COMMIT/ABORT) + NewDirectByteBuffer box registry; the engine-side primitive_array/primitive_array_write hooks snapshot the DEX heap array[i] fields into REAL malloc memory and commit back with per-element memcmp skip (32MB honest bound).
implemented_laws.F-NEW-606: ELEMENT-TYPE-FAMILY law — the snapshot read ONLY INT32/INT64/FLOAT32 while the engine's own producers (aput-byte/char/short/boolean, InputStream.read) store BYTE/CHAR/SHORT/BOOLEAN typed values: the 31435B icons.png snapshot arrived as ZEROS and the commit pass then WROTE ZEROS over the live PNG bytes (data destruction — the 'commit 31435/31435 changed' tell). Snapshot and commit now read/write the full family per element width; the commit writes the descriptor-canonical make_* form (no representation drift). Rejection paths print the array's identity (desc) honestly.
implemented_laws.F-NEW-607: DESCRIPTOR-EXACT NATIVE SELECTION — the native-precedence scan matched by NAME only: Matrix4 declares BOTH the static native mul([F[F)V and the virtual bytecode wrapper mul(Matrix4)LMatrix4;; the name-only scan served the static native to the virtual call (two Matrix4 receivers marshalled as 'float[]' criticals -> slot-222 NULL -> guarded SIGSEGV -> NPE -> APP BOUNDARY). ART order restored: pass 1 exact (name, descriptor)+ACC_NATIVE; pass 2 name-only ONLY when the exact method does not exist in the class at all (the W10 conscrypt law verbatim for descriptor-unknown dispatches).
implemented_laws.F-NEW-608: String.toCharArray (STRING_REF + heap-String faces, AOSP value.clone semantics, make_char elements) + the Character statics on the same demand chain (isAlphabetic/isLetter/toUpperCase/toLowerCase — ASCII + byte-char law, the honest boundary recorded). Live face: AssetLoaderService.createCharset died on array-length of the unbridged toCharArray result (ARR-LEN-NULL).
implemented_laws.F-NEW-608b: String.getChars(I I [C I) both faces — AOSP bounds law (StringIndexOutOfBounds for the src range, IndexOutOfBounds for dst overflow). Live face: the I18NBundle name composition emptied every bundle name (StringBuilder.append0 -> getChars stub).
implemented_laws.F-NEW-608c: String<-char[] materialization (new String([C) and the ( [C I I) window form with the AOSP bounds law). Live face: libgdx's own StringBuilder.toString() minted UNMATERIALIZED strings — every composed bundle name degraded to "".
implemented_laws.F-NEW-608d: STRING-ARG DUAL-FACE read law — a String argument arrives as inline STRING_REF or a MATERIALIZED heap String (__string_value__/value/sb_value); the File-ctor and String.replace laws read the CHARACTER CONTENT regardless of representation. Live faces: the freshly-minted 'strings_en_US.properties' degraded to "" inside File.<init>(String,String) and inside AndroidFileHandle.sibling's name.replace('\\','/').
implemented_laws.F-NEW-609: PERSISTENT DIRECT-BUFFER BACKING — GetDirectBufferAddress snapshotted the DEX mirror into a FRESH malloc per call; a native that WRITES through the address (BufferUtils.copyJni streaming the 126168B TTF) had its bytes erased by the next reader's snapshot (FreeType newMemoryFace read zeros -> face=0 -> GdxRuntimeException). JNI direct buffers are SHARED memory: the first Get mints the persistent backing, every later Get returns THE SAME pointer (documented boundary: DEX-side writes after the first Get are not re-snapshotted — the font/pixmap consumers are native-side only).
implemented_laws.F-NEW-611: JNI NAME MANGLING law — mangle_escape passed every printable byte through; '$' (U+0024) survived raw while the .so exports the ART-faithful _00024 form. dlsym missed EVERY inner-class native (the whole FreeType Library/Face/Bitmap/Glyph family). One rule: every char outside [A-Za-z0-9_] carries _0xxxx; / ; [ keep their table entries.
implemented_laws.F-NEW-613: DEX-HIERARCHY SHADOW-CLAIM GATE — the ViewShadow EXP-060 catch-all claims every class outside the known framework prefixes ('could be a View subclass') and its dispatch answers View-geometry getters (getHeight/getWidth) with typed 0. libgdx's FreeType$GlyphMetrics.getHeight(J)I — a REAL ACC_NATIVE — was shadowed to 0 before the real-symbol attempt (x-height stayed 0 -> 'No x-height character found in font' -> APP BOUNDARY) while getHoriAdvance (not a View getter) ran REAL. Gate: a shadow-IMPLEMENTED answer on a DEX-present native class is authoritative only when the declared superclass chain reaches an Landroid/ ancestor; otherwise the claim is demoted to the FIX-TTT fault-fallback and the real symbol runs (the tower3d faulting-allocator observable unchanged).
